title: Without Delete, the tracking switch shows but cannot be changed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a custom role for this test, role B, with Part Library & Inventory — View, Part Library & Inventory — Create & Edit and See Financial Data but without Part Library & Inventory — Delete, so user B can create and edit parts but cannot delete them.
  • Create a staff member for this test, user B, at the test location with role B, so the steps run with role B's permissions.
  • Use two browser windows: window 1 signed in as the Admin, window 2 (a private window) signed in as user B, so both users' screens can be seen side by side.
  • Have a tracked part, part A, with 2 on hand.
  • Have an untracked part, part B.
  • Start window 2 on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. In window 2, type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. In window 2, click the part A row.
  3. In window 2, click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch.
  4. In window 2, click Cancel.
  5. In window 2, type part B's part number in the Search box.
  6. In window 2, click the part B row.
  7. In window 2, click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch.
  8. In window 2, click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed for user B.

Step 2:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens: the Track quantities and cost of goods switch is shown, on, and greyed out (disabled).

Step 3:

  • Nothing changes: the switch stays on and Min and Max stay visible.

Step 4:

  • The window closes without saving.

Step 5:

  • Part B is listed, reading "Not Tracked".

Step 6:

  • The switch is shown, off and greyed out, so user B can read that part B is untracked.

Step 7:

  • The switch stays off and Min and Max stay hidden.

Step 8:

  • The window closes, and part B still reads "Not Tracked".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10821 (Story 8, Permissions), story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part)

  • S8-R8: “Changing an existing part's tracking, in either direction, requires the same permission.”
  • S8-R9: “A user without that permission sees the tracking switch disabled, so they can read the state but not change it.”
  • S5-N2: “A user without the 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' permission sees the switch disabled (S8-R9).”
